description: Minimal capability for the main window. The dsh web UI uses no Tauri IPC of its own; the only consumers are the two injected scripts (drag region and the Ctrl+Q close shortcut), so only core defaults plus those two window permissions are granted. Downloads are handled Rust-side via on_download and uploads use the standard file input, so fs/dialog/shell/global-shortcut permissions were removed: they granted the remote page (http://127.0.0.1:3080) unused filesystem/shell reach that only expanded the attack surface.
